excerpt.zh: 你可以指派总督管理整个星域。星域内的所有£planet£星球都将从总督的技能中受益。我们应当为我们的新星域指派一位总督。
excerpt.en: Governors can be assigned to administrate entire Sectors. All £planet£ Planets within the sector will then benefit from the Governor's skills. We should assign one to our new sector.
